# Version selection fixtures

These eight version manifests are unchanged copies from
[microsoft/winget-pkgs at cd687a7](https://github.com/microsoft/winget-pkgs/tree/cd687a7b788649b57f9c88d3d31d44b33724c05c/manifests/a).
Paths below `a/` match upstream. Keep Marksman's ISO date unquoted to exercise
PyYAML's date conversion. These samples cover rejected-version ties and mixed
version formats; they do not represent a full catalog audit.
